projects.title: Kernel Lab: correct operators, measured systems results
projects.description: An independent GPU engineering repository spanning CUDA, Triton, PyTorch integration, and Pallas, with a supplied tiny decoder workload and a reproducible systems report.
requirements: Keep a shape/dtype/layout/precision contract and edge-case tests for every advertised custom operator.
Provide raw repeated timings, pinned hardware/software manifests, synchronized timing boundaries, and eager/compiled framework baselines.
Show actual supported-dtype gradients and decoder-level parity for custom RMSNorm; CPU gradcheck alone is insufficient.
Include actual H100 Pallas evidence, or label that requirement incomplete if hardware execution remains blocked.
Measure model-level prefill and cached decode using deterministic fixture weights; do not claim trained-model quality or frontier-scale speedups.
Package reproducible scripts, a focused report, clean-checkout evidence, and a legitimate contribution draft where a real issue was found.
